content.markdown: All render Styles in order; each has a unique `style_name` under the shared SNL identifier policy. In `foo[bar](x)`, the parser records the explicit selector and rendering resolves `style_name === "bar"`; unknown names are a render-time error. Every Macro has at least one Style. At the 0.3.3 baseline, `styles[0]` is the implicit default for current data. Under the planned 0.3.4 contract in `spec.rv.automatic-style-selection-034`, an omitted selector first permits conservative exact-filled-slot inference for eligible fixed-arity text/formula Styles, with array order breaking multiple exact matches. `styles[0]` remains the fallback when no eligible exact match exists and for excluded cases. Explicit selectors and deprecated runtime `default_style` mapping keep their existing precedence and errors. No implementation is claimed here.
